allow: PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_DiskDrive | Select-Object Model, @{N='Size_GB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Size/1GB,0\)}}, InterfaceType, FirmwareRevision)
PowerShell(Get-Disk | Select-Object Number, FriendlyName, @{N='Size_GB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Size/1GB,0\)}}, BusType, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus)

PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -notin @\('svchost','System','Idle','Registry','smss','csrss','wininit','winlogon','lsass','fontdrvhost','dwm','spoolsv','WmiPrvSE','conhost','RuntimeBroker','dllhost','taskhostw','sihost','ctfmon','SearchHost','StartMenuExperienceHost','ShellExperienceHost','TextInputHost','SecurityHealthSysHost','MsMpEng','NisSrv','SgrmBroker','audiodg','WUDFHost','UserOOBEBroker'\)} | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object Name, Id, @{N='RAM_MB';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1\)}}, @{N='CPU_s';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU,1\)}}, Path | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell($groups = Get-Process | Group-Object Name | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{Name=$_.Name; Count=$_.Count; TotalMB=[math]::Round\(\($_.Group | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum\).Sum/1MB,1\)} } | Sort-Object TotalMB -Descending | Select-Object -First 20; $groups | Format-Table -AutoSize; $total = \(Get-Process | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum\).Sum / 1MB; Write-Output "Total visible process RAM: $\([math]::Round\($total,0\)\) MB")

PowerShell(Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceDescription -match "Wi-Fi|Wireless|802.11|WLAN" } | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, Status, LinkSpeed, DriverVersion, DriverDate, DriverFileName, MacAddress | Format-List)

PowerShell(Get-WmiObject Win32_NetworkAdapter | Where-Object { $_.AdapterType -match "Ethernet 802.11" -or $_.Description -match "Wi-Fi|Wireless|802.11|WLAN" } | Select-Object Name, Description, DeviceID, Manufacturer, ServiceName | Format-List)
